name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the conversation over to a human support agent and open a support ticket. Use only when you cannot resolve the issue yourself: the order cannot be found, the customer explicitly asks for a person, or the problem needs a refund, replacement or other action you have no tool for. Do not escalate questions you have already answered.

reason.description: One or two sentences for the human agent summarising the customer's problem and why it is being escalated.
